# Figma

> Figma is a collaborative, cloud-based design platform that unifies design, prototyping, development, and team collaboration with AI-powered features and integrations for modern product teams.

Figma offers a comprehensive suite of tools including Design, Dev Mode, FigJam, Slides, Draw, Buzz, Sites, and Make, enabling teams to design, prototype, and build products collaboratively. The platform integrates with developer tools like VS Code and Cursor through MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, bridging the gap between design and development workflows.

## Key Topics

- Design collaboration
- Dev Mode
- Design systems
- Prototyping
- AI-powered design
- FigJam whiteboarding
- Design-to-code workflow
- Component management
- Interactive design
- Website builder
- Team collaboration
- Responsive design
- Design tokens
- Developer tools
- MCP integration

## Core Products

- [Figma: The Collaborative Interface Design Tool](https://www.figma.com): Figma homepage showcasing collaborative design platform with Make, Dev Mode, Buzz, and Sites
- [Figma Design: Free Design Tool for Websites, Product Design & More](https://www.figma.com/design): Core design product featuring vector graphics, real-time collaboration, and comprehensive design tools
- [Dev Mode: Design-to-Development](https://www.figma.com/dev-mode): Design-to-code workflow enabling seamless handoff with VS Code and Cursor integration
- [Figma Sites: Design, Prototype & Publish Your Next Website](https://www.figma.com/sites): All-in-one website design, prototyping, and publishing platform with built-in CMS
- [Figma Make: Create with AI-Powered Design Tools](https://www.figma.com/make): AI-powered design generation and web app building for rapid prototyping
- [Figma AI: Your Creativity, unblocked with Figma AI](https://www.figma.com/ai): AI features across Make, Sites, and design automation for accelerated workflows
- [FigJam: The Online Collaborative Whiteboard for Teams](https://www.figma.com/figjam): Collaborative whiteboarding platform for brainstorming, diagramming, and team ideation
- [Figma Slides: Create Presentations & Slides for Every Occasion](https://www.figma.com/slides): AI-powered presentation creation tool for collaborative slide design and storytelling
- [Figma Draw: Creative Tools for Illustration & Visual Design](https://www.figma.com/draw): Illustration and vector editing tools for creative visual storytelling and design
- [Figma Buzz: Create & Share On-Brand Assets Instantly](https://www.figma.com/buzz): On-brand asset creation and distribution platform for team consistency

## Design & Prototyping Tools

- [Design Systems: Online Design System Software For Teams](https://www.figma.com/design-systems): Manage components, tokens, variables, and design systems for enterprise team collaboration
- [Prototyping: Free Prototyping Tool for Interactive Designs](https://www.figma.com/prototyping): Interactive design, animations, and responsive mockups for product validation
- [UX Design Tool: Free Online UX Design Tool & Software](https://www.figma.com/ux-design-tool): User experience prototyping with real-time collaboration and design testing
- [Web Design: Free Online Web Design Tool for Teams](https://www.figma.com/web-design): Responsive website design with Dev Mode integration and design system support
- [Wireframe Tool: Free Online Wireframe Tool For Teams](https://www.figma.com/wireframe-tool): Collaborative wireframing with templates for rapid visual communication

## FigJam Collaboration

- [FigJam Online Whiteboard: Free Online Whiteboard for Teams](https://www.figma.com/figjam/online-whiteboard): Free team brainstorming and interactive diagramming on collaborative whiteboard
- [FigJam Agile Workflows: Agile Workflow Tool & Online Scrum Board](https://www.figma.com/figjam/agile-workflows): Sprint planning, stand-ups, and Jira/Asana integrations for agile teams

## Developer Integration & Reference

- [Figma MCP Catalog](https://www.figma.com/mcp-catalog): MCP server catalog for integrating Figma with VS Code, Cursor, and Claude Code

## Getting Started & Downloads

- [Figma Downloads: Web Design App for Desktops & Mobile](https://www.figma.com/downloads): Desktop, mobile, and cross-platform app installations for all devices
